tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm charcoal, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, segmented controls, inputs on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment, bar tracks, inactive stars, tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and row dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Chip, input and segmented borders; the result card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Row labels, secondary copy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels (uppercase), captions, units. 6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Primary action, selected chip, hydration bar, resting state. Text on it: on-ember.

tokens.name: ember-bright
tokens.usage: Key numbers 28px and up, links, tip-card title. 3:1 minimum, large text only in light.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember.

tokens.name: ember-tint
tokens.usage: Oven tip card and current step background.

tokens.name: ember-line
tokens.usage: Border of ember-tint cards.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Cold stage, done state, progress, calibration apply button. Text on it: on-ember in dark, white in light.

tokens.name: sage-bright
tokens.usage: Good-outcome tags, ready-at time, hint title.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: Calibration hint card, good-outcome tag background.

tokens.name: sage-line
tokens.usage: Border of sage-tint cards.

tokens.name: wheat
tokens.usage: Hands-on step state (knead, fold, ball up) in rings and tracks.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Bad-outcome tags, remove actions. Never for emphasis.

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Bad-outcome tag background.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets.

tokens.name: photo-a
tokens.usage: Photo placeholder gradient start.

tokens.name: photo-b
tokens.usage: Photo placeholder gradient end.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Tip and hint copy, segmented labels (500).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines under rows, units, dates. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in ink-muted (or ember-bright / sage-bright on tinted cards).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Any inline value. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and chips. 16px/700 for the primary CTA.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip gaps inside tags, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards between controls; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards is 14px (space-3 + 2).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks on long pages.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top inset under the Android status bar.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control.

tokens.name: tap-cta
tokens.usage: Primary CTA height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, small kind icons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented buttons, step buttons, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tip cards, photo placeholders, selects.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, FAB.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, bars, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inputs; animates (glow).
